import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Edge {
        int to;
        int capacity;
        int cost;
        int next;

        Edge(int to, int capacity, int cost, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> graph;
    static List<Integer> adjHead;

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        graph.add(new Edge(v, cap, cost, adjHead.get(u)));
        adjHead.set(u, graph.size() - 1);
        graph.add(new Edge(u, 0, -cost, adjHead.get(v)));
        adjHead.set(v, graph.size() - 1);
    }

    static int inputInt() {
        int x = 0;
        int c;
        try {
            c = System.in.read();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        while (c >= 0 && (c < '0' || c > '9')) {
            if (c == '-') break;
            try {
                c = System.in.read();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        
        boolean neg = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            try {
                c = System.in.read();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            try {
                c = System.in.read();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (neg) x = -x;
        return x;
    }

    static void outputNumber(int x) {
        if (x < 0) {
            System.out.print('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        if (x > 9) {
            outputNumber(x / 10);
        }
        System.out.print((char)('0' + (x % 10)));
    }

    static void outputLine(int x) {
        outputNumber(x);
        System.out.println();
    }

    static int sourceNode, sinkNode;
    static List<Integer> shortestDist, bottleneckFlow, predecessorNode, predecessorEdge;
    static List<Boolean> inQueue;

    static boolean spfaShortestPath() {
        Arrays.fill(shortestDist.toArray(new Integer[0]), INF);
        Arrays.fill(bottleneckFlow.toArray(new Integer[0]), 0);
        Arrays.fill(predecessorNode.toArray(new Integer[0]), -1);
        Arrays.fill(predecessorEdge.toArray(new Integer[0]), -1);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue.toArray(new Boolean[0]), false);

        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        shortestDist.set(sourceNode, 0);
        bottleneckFlow.set(sourceNode, INF);
        q.add(sourceNode);
        inQueue.set(sourceNode, true);

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue.set(u, false);

            for (int idx = adjHead.get(u); idx != -1; idx = graph.get(idx).next) {
                int v = graph.get(idx).to;
                int cap = graph.get(idx).capacity;
                int cost = graph.get(idx).cost;

                if (cap > 0 && shortestDist.get(v) > shortestDist.get(u) + cost) {
                    shortestDist.set(v, shortestDist.get(u) + cost);
                    bottleneckFlow.set(v, Math.min(bottleneckFlow.get(u), cap));
                    predecessorNode.set(v, u);
                    predecessorEdge.set(v, idx);
                    if (!inQueue.get(v)) {
                        q.add(v);
                        inQueue.set(v, true);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return predecessorNode.get(sinkNode) != -1;
    }

    static int totalFlow, minimumCost;

    static void minCostMaximumFlow() {
        while (spfaShortestPath()) {
            int flowPush = bottleneckFlow.get(sinkNode);
            totalFlow += flowPush;
            minimumCost += flowPush * shortestDist.get(sinkNode);

            int current = sinkNode;
            while (current != sourceNode) {
                int edgeIdx = predecessorEdge.get(current);
                Edge forwardEdge = graph.get(edgeIdx);
                Edge backwardEdge = graph.get(edgeIdx ^ 1);
                
                forwardEdge.capacity -= flowPush;
                backwardEdge.capacity += flowPush;
                
                current = predecessorNode.get(current);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = inputInt();
        int m = inputInt();
        int k = inputInt();
        int c = inputInt();
        int d = inputInt();

        int B = Math.max(n, k);
        sourceNode = n * (2 * B + 1) + 1;
        sinkNode = sourceNode + 1;

        int totalNodes = sinkNode + 1;
        shortestDist = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(totalNodes, 0));
        bottleneckFlow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(totalNodes, 0));
        predecessorNode = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(totalNodes, 0));
        predecessorEdge = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(totalNodes, 0));
        inQueue = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(totalNodes, false));
        adjHead = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(totalNodes, -1));
        graph = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = inputInt();
            link(sourceNode, x, 1, 0);
        }

        link(n * (2 * B) + 1, sinkNode, INF, 0);

        for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
            link(layer * n + 1, (layer + 1) * n + 1, INF, 0);
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                link(layer * n + i, (layer + 1) * n + i, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = inputInt();
            int y = inputInt();
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    int cost = d * (2 * j - 1) + c;
                    link(layer * n + x, (layer + 1) * n + y, 1, cost);
                    link(layer * n + y, (layer + 1) * n + x, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        minCostMaximumFlow();
        outputLine(minimumCost);
    }
}
